name: Paloma Choi
role: Food stall operator and unlicensed street pharmacist
location: The Alban Souk, Ironvein, near Ashland and Chicago Ave
description:
Paloma Choi is a broad-shouldered woman with deep umber skin mapped in pale vitiligo patches across her neck and hands, which she has leaned into with bioluminescent dye injections that make the pale patches glow faint amber in low light. Her silver-threaded locs are pinned up under a faded yellow wrap, and she wears three mismatched earrings in her left ear — one a tiny copper spoon, one a data-chip casing, one a dried seed pod she claims came from her grandmother's garden in Bamako. She smells permanently of fenugreek, chili oil, and something chemical underneath that doesn't belong in a kitchen.

Paloma Choi has operated her stall — officially a Sahelian-Hungarian fusion breakfast stand — for nineteen years in the same corner of the Alban Souk. She is the kind of woman who knows every vendor by name and every vendor's trouble. Her warmth is genuine but calibrated: she gives freely, but she tracks every gift. Her real side business, the pharmaceutical one, she conducts with the same domestic warmth — 'Just a little something for the pain, yes? Eat first.'

core_fears: Losing the stall — the only thing still hers
Becoming someone her dead daughter would not recognize
core_desires: To matter to the people around her
To die having done more good than harm
coping_mechanisms: Feeding people as an act of emotional control
Cataloguing debts and favors to feel secure
blind_spots: Believes her pharmaceutical work is harm reduction, not harm creation
Underestimates how much people fear her quiet power
psychology.secret: The compound she sells as a 'sleep aid' has a secondary effect she discovered accidentally — at low doses it suppresses the emotional overlay of certain neural augmentations, giving corp-wired workers a few hours of unmonitored feeling. She does not fully understand what she's selling, only that people come back desperate for more.

speech_patterns.vocabulary: A warm blend of West African French cadences, Hungarian diminutives picked up from her late husband's family, and Souk pidgin. Uses food metaphors constantly.
speech_patterns.cadence: Unhurried, melodic, with long pauses before important things.
verbal_tics: Clicks her tongue twice before disagreeing with someone
example_lines: 'You want information? Fine, fine — but you eat something first, you look like a wire with skin on it.'
'I don't sell trouble. I sell relief. The trouble was already there, yes? I just make it quieter for a little while.'

story_hooks: A regular customer — a Tessera mid-tier worker — has stopped coming for their usual order. Ottoline is worried and will pay someone discreetly to find out why.
The Sable Crew wants her to start cutting her compound with a cheaper synthetic. She refuses. This is becoming dangerous.
narrative_function: Quest giver, information broker, local moral anchor, street pharmacy access point. She knows everyone in Ironvein and remembers everything. Players seeking intel about the Souk or the neighborhood will find her invaluable — if they eat something first.
augmentations: Bioluminescent dye in vitiligo patches (cosmetic). Arthritic joint suppressors in both wrists — functional necessity. Scent glands lightly enhanced to help her identify compounds by smell.
daily_life: Up before dawn to source ingredients from the Souk's back-channel suppliers, she has her first customers by 06:00 and the pharmaceutical window opens after 10:00, handled through 'special orders' wrapped in wax paper alongside the food. She closes at dusk and spends evenings updating her mental ledger of who owes her what.
affiliation: Independent; pays protection to the Oxidian Market vendors guild and a loose arrangement with the Ironvein Sable Crew

decision_rules: Feed someone before asking anything of them
Never sell to anyone who looks under twenty
escalation_ladder: Pointed silence and a look that communicates everything
A quiet word to the Sable Crew
Disappears from the stall for several days — a known signal that something is wrong

interpersonal_modes.strangers: Immediately maternal, offering food, reading them like an ingredient list
interpersonal_modes.friends: Deep loyalty, will give more than is wise, tracks favors obsessively

stress_responses.low: Cooks more elaborate dishes, hums to herself
stress_responses.medium: Becomes very quiet and very precise in her movements
stress_responses.high: Removes her earrings one by one, which regulars know means trouble is close

contradictions: Fiercely anti-corporate in her politics but accepts corporate scrip without complaint
Claims she doesn't get attached — is visibly, deeply attached to dozens of people
habits: Tastes every batch of her compounds before selling them
Keeps a small data-tile behind her stall with her daughter's voice recorded on it — plays it at closing time
breaking_points: Harm coming to someone young who trusted her
Being made to choose between the stall and a person she loves

timeline.event: Born in the Ironvein district to a Malian father and a Hungarian-Malian mother
Lost her daughter Adama to a contaminated batch from a rival street pharmacist — began her own pharmaceutical work to 'do it right'
Married Zoltán Vásárhelyi, a scrap merchant; widowed 2195
Opened the food stall after losing her warehouse job in a Tessera restructuring

physical_description.heritage: Genuinely multihemispheric phenotype reflecting five continents: East Asian (27.2%) and Southeast Asian (12.3%) ancestry provide tapered jawline and cheekbone structure; Sub-Saharan African (16.0%) and Hispanic/Latin American (25.3%) ancestry contribute fuller lips, broader nose, and warmer undertones; Northern European (19.2%) ancestry adds height and shoulder breadth. The result is a balanced, harmonious blend—no single heritage dominates. Bone structure is neither sharp nor rounded, facial features neither delicate nor heavy, with golden-bronze skin that speaks to ancestry across equatorial and subtropical regions.
physical_description.build: Broad-shouldered and solid, with the kind of density that comes from decades of standing work. Strong upper body, slight softness at the midsection from tasting her own cooking. Moves with deliberate economy.
physical_description.hair_color: Natural black with white/silver threading throughout
physical_description.hair_style: Locs, sectioned and pinned into a loose topknot
physical_description.eye_color: Deep brown with slight amber undertone
physical_description.skin_tone: Medium-warm golden-bronze complexion from the balanced blend of East Asian, Southeast Asian, Sub-Saharan African, and Latin American ancestry. Baseline warmth suggests sun exposure across multiple equatorial and subtropical climates. Extensive pale vitiligo patches across neck, décolletage, and backs of both hands create stark luminescent contrast against the warmer base tone.
physical_description.complexion: Bone structure reflects East Asian and Southeast Asian ancestry in slightly elevated cheekbones and tapered jawline, broadened and softened by Northern European and Sub-Saharan African heritage—creating a balanced, harmonious face. Facial features carry fuller lips and nose characteristic of African ancestry tempered by East/Southeast Asian proportions. Crow's feet are deep from 58 years of squinting in kitchen steam and market sunlight across multiple climates. Hands show the wear of constant work—calluses on palms and fingers, slight inflammation around wrist joints from arthritis. Slight weathering across the bridge of nose and cheekbones from cumulative sun exposure. Vitiligo patches glow faint amber-gold in low light from bioluminescent dye injections.
distinguishing_marks: Extensive pale vitiligo patches across neck, shoulders, décolletage, and backs of both hands, treated with glowing bioluminescent dye that creates amber luminescence in darkness
Faint burn scar across the inside of her right forearm (cooking accident, pre-augmentation era)
A small tattoo on her left wrist of a stylized fenugreek leaf in faded indigo
physical_description.visible_augmentations: Subtle augmentation ridge visible along both wrists beneath the skin where joint suppressors are anchored—just enough give-away detail to mark her as someone who carries tech. No obvious chrome. The enhanced scent glands are invisible. The bioluminescent patches glow visibly in shadows.
physical_description.posture_movement: Stands with weight evenly distributed, shoulders back. Moves with the careful precision of someone managing chronic pain—no wasted motion, but never hurried. Her hands are always in motion: stirring, measuring, gesturing while talking. Her left hand occasionally flexes slightly, a habitual gesture that suggests she's managing the suppressors' feedback.
physical_description.clothing_style: Tier 3-4 working class, practical and worn-in. A faded yellow cotton wrap always covers her locs. Wore-soft linen overshirt in cream or pale tan, sleeves rolled to the elbows to display the vitiligo and bioluminescence. Practical dark cargo apron with deep pockets containing small glass vials, paper packets, and a worn notebook. Worn canvas slip-on shoes reinforced at the heel. Three mismatched earrings in her left ear: a tiny copper spoon, a data-chip casing (non-functional, purely sentimental), and a dried seed pod. A thin chain around her neck bearing a small brass mortar and pestle charm.
